principle: Single Source of Truth. No graphic, email, BOM or CAD may contradict this file.

status_model.FIXED: Project decision; may only change via explicit EVT6 change request.
status_model.VALIDATED_ARCH: Architecture is supported by source/component capabilities; production details may still require implementation validation.
status_model.TARGET: Desired implementation target; exact manufacturer item may still change.
status_model.HOLD: Must not be represented as production-confirmed until blocker is closed.
status_model.DEFERRED: Intentionally not claimed or released in EVT6.
